title: TabSOM: A tabular-to-image encoding method based on self-organizing maps
abstract: arXiv:2608.13513v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tabular-to-image methods have emerged as novel approaches to leverage the high predictive performance of convolutional neural networks and vision transformers. They convert tabular data into image representations, mapping each feature at a fixed pixel location derived from a dimensionality-reduction method (e.g., t-SNE, UMAP, PCA). However, they encode only the marginal value of each feature and discard information about feature relationships. translated_title: TabSOM：基于自组织映射的表格数据到图像编码方法
translated_abstract: 表格到图像的转换方法已成为利用卷积神经网络和视觉变换器高预测性能的新兴途径。这些方法将表格数据转换为图像表示，通过降维方法（如t-SNE、UMAP、PCA）将每个特征映射到固定像素位置。然而，它们仅编码每个特征的边缘值，而丢弃了特征之间的关系信息。我们提出了TabSOM，一种基于自组织映射（SOM）的表格到图像编码方法，其提供：（i）一种空间布局，其中每个输入特征通过无冲突的匈牙利分配，在其组件平面上占据固定的画布位置；（ii）一个从SOM组件平面派生的图，用于捕获成对特征关系。生成的图像堆叠了两个多尺度节点通道：一个以固定尺度编码特征值，另一个编码成对特征关系。
tldr: TabSOM是一种基于自组织映射的表格数据编码方法，通过固定位置布局和特征关系图，同时编码特征值及其成对关系，以提升卷积神经网络的预测性能。
en_tdlr: TabSOM is a self-organizing-map-based tabular-to-image encoding method that captures both feature values and pairwise relationships via a fixed spatial layout and feature-relationship graph, enhancing CNN predictive performance.
